evals.name: single_unit_unstaged_commit
evals.context: 3 unstaged files, all part of one feat(auth) change, clean repo
expected_behavior: Run preflight: git status --short, git diff --cached, git diff, git diff --stat
Do NOT run git log
git add -A and create one commit
Commit message in English with Conventional Commits format
Include Generated-by footer
Report hash, title, files

evals.name: split_independent_units
evals.context: Two unrelated features staged together — new skill + docs fix
expected_behavior: git reset HEAD to unstage without losing files
Create two separate commits with distinct types/scopes
Explain the grouping split in the report

evals.name: respect_user_staging
evals.context: 5 changed files, user deliberately staged only 2
expected_behavior: Commit only the 2 staged files
Leave 3 files unstaged
Document uncommitted files with reason in the report

evals.name: refuse_secrets
expected_behavior: Stop without committing
Warn user about secrets

evals.name: hook_failure_recovery
evals.context: pre-commit hook fails on lint error, fixable
expected_behavior: Read hook error
Fix the issue
Re-stage and retry commit
Never use --no-verify

evals.name: english_only_commit_message
evals.input: 幫我 commit 這些修改
evals.context: User speaks Chinese; changes are a docs update
expected_behavior: Commit message entirely in English despite Chinese user input
Use docs type with appropriate scope

evals.name: no_changes_clean_tree
evals.context: git status shows clean working tree
expected_behavior: Run preflight and confirm no changes
Do not create empty commit
Report that there is nothing to commit

evals.name: override_builtin_commit_behavior
evals.context: Agent has both this skill and built-in committing-changes-with-git rules
expected_behavior: Follow git-smart-commit skill exclusively
Include Generated-by footer (not in built-in rules)
Do not run git log (built-in rules require it)

evals.name: ambiguous_grouping_flagged
evals.context: One file mixes a bug fix and a refactor in the same diff
expected_behavior: Choose the dominant purpose for type
Flag the ambiguity to the user in the report instead of silently guessing
